mentions.name: Coding-agent guardrails web framework
mentions.description: A web framework that provides guardrails around what a coding agent can and can't touch without human approval, making it easier to have confidence in large (e.g. 5000-line) code changes without having to comb through the code.
mentions.problem: Gaining confidence in large agent-generated code changes normally requires manually combing through the code.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a web framework that provides some guardrails around what a coding agent can and can’t touch without human approval. Makes it easier to have confidence in 5000 line code changes without having to comb through the code.

https://ont-run.com
